category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response holds the line with wit and substance, acknowledging playoff results without conceding superiority and bringing up depth, NFL draft counts, and the gauntlet of SEC play.
quote: Week in and week out, top to bottom, nobody plays the gauntlet the SEC plays. Your contenders get to fatten up on cupcakes. Ours are surviving a murderer's row every single Saturday. There's a reason "It Just Means More" isn't a slogan—it's a scoreboard.
